title: Privacy Policy
para1: Kubo Saving does not collect, store, sell, or share personal data with us or third parties.
para2: All financial information entered in the app is stored locally on your device and is not transmitted to any external server by Kubo Saving.
para3: The app may use Apple system services, such as iCloud, backups, or system sharing features, depending on your device settings. These services are governed by Apple's privacy policy.
para4: If you contact us for support, we may receive the information you choose to provide, such as your email address and message content, solely to respond to your request.
contactQuestion: Do you have any questions about your privacy?
supportPara: Do you have a question, suggestion, or found an issue? We're here to help you get the most out of your finances.
supportNote: We will try to respond as soon as possible (usually within 24-48 hours).
